title: God demands a surrender.
paragraphs: Sounds comforting… until you read the fine print of heaven.

Because Scripture never says,
“Be good and be saved.”
It never says,
“Try harder and I’ll accept you.”
It says something far more unsettling.
“Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.” — Luke 9:23
But we resist the word surrender.

We want Jesus as Rescuer…
without Jesus as Lord.

We want heaven…
without a crucified life.
There is no salvation without surrender.
“If you confess with your mouth, ‘Jesus is Lord,’ and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.” — Romans 10:9
A.S.I.S. is biblical because salvation is not a transaction—

You don’t add Jesus to your life.
He takes over your life.
“I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.” — Galatians 2:20
And this is why it’s necessary for all—
Because sin isn’t just what you did.
It’s who you are without Christ.
No amount of effort can fix a throne problem.
But here’s where grace walks in—
God is not asking you to surrender so He can destroy you.

He’s asking you to surrender
so He can save the real you.

The one buried under sin.
The one He died for.
“Whoever loses their life for My sake will find it.” — Matthew 16:25
A.S.I.S. is not just a slogan.

Surrender is not the price of salvation—
it’s the evidence that salvation has begun.

Lay it down.
The pride.
The hidden sin.
The control.
And watch grace rewrite your story.
Someone you love is still holding on.
